feed_candidates.title: Landry Shamet March Madness highlights at Wichita State
feed_candidates.body: Before putting together an 8-year NBA career and becoming a key bench piece for the 2026 New York Knicks, Landry Shamet was starting point guard for two Wichita State March Madness teams in 2017 and 2018. Watch his NCAA tournament career highlights here.

feed_candidates.title: Spurs coach Mitch Johnson in March Madness: 9 points, 15 assists, game-winning dime in 2008 OT win
feed_candidates.body: Watch highlights of current San Antonio Spurs coach Mitch Johnson from his playing days at Stanford in the 2008 NCAA tournament. In this second round March Madness game against Marquette, the point guard finished with nine points, 15 assists and just one turnover en route to a last-second OT win.
